original_test_intent: Verify the complete PWR power-reading sensor population against the authoritative PSU/rail/board/device power topology, reconciling identity, watts or other defined units, states and limits across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: Bind every PWR record to its power domain, source, load and aggregation level; retain complete aligned IB/OOB inventories and Web pages; normalize units/scaling and expected load-dependent values/limits; compare each member passively and, only if the specification requires accuracy validation, correlate an approved independent meter/reference.
manual_activity: The power owner supplies the PWR population/topology and decides independent-reference scope plus criteria 3–45; an operator records load/power state and complete Web mapping, then the owner issues the verdict.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-domain PWR matrix with source/load/aggregation identity, compare complete IB/OOB/Web telemetry under a fixed workload and add calibrated-reference evidence only when explicitly required.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds topology, load and metrology boundaries while preserving passive source coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic PWR match may mix PSU input/output, rail or board totals and double-count aggregates; cross-interface equality alone does not prove measurement accuracy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Telemetry depends on load and aggregation cadence; independent live measurement has separate safety requirements.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria jump from 2 to 46; DeepSeek requests PDB evidence and a title-based sensor, and shared code also names INA/OVRM and PDB variants. Row-2028 PWR coverage is isolated and unresolved scope is escalated.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2028 variant 465c39de1bd9b963 of shared code Wistron-HW-00483-V002: define the complete PWR sensor population/topology, units/scaling/aggregation and load-dependent limits; decide whether acceptance requires only IB/OOB/Web parity or also an approved independent power reference; confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 46 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–45 are missing, while keeping rows 2202 and 2274 separate.

review_improvement: Quarantines PDB and INA/OVRM variants, turns generic PWR matching into a topology-aware per-member comparison and makes the independent-reference boundary explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: Power readings may be PSU input, PSU output, rail, device or board aggregates, so broad PWR matching can mix unlike values or double-count hierarchy levels. Cross-surface agreement often reflects the same underlying sensor and therefore proves presentation consistency, not accuracy. A separate reference is needed only if the owner defines that coverage, and criteria 3–45 cannot be inferred.
